process.heading: Brief, footage, editing, feedback, delivery
process.intro: Five clear steps from first message to final files. At every stage you know what has happened, what happens next and what I need from you.

steps.title: Brief
steps.detail: Start with a short guided form about your project, audience and goals. The questions adapt to your type of content, so you only answer what matters. I read every request and reply within one business day, then send a fixed-scope quote with the deliverables, turnaround and revision rounds. You accept it, sign the agreement and pay the invoice in your client portal.
steps.youDo: Answer the guided questions (about 3 minutes), then review and accept the quote.
steps.weDo: I review your answers, suggest a call if it would help, and send a clear quote.

steps.title: Footage
steps.detail: Upload footage, logos, scripts, references and music straight to your project. Your brand kit is saved, so repeat projects start faster. Once the brief is complete and your files are in, the schedule starts.
steps.youDo: Upload your footage and assets and finish the project brief.
steps.weDo: I check that everything arrived, set up your project folders and confirm the schedule.

steps.title: Editing
steps.detail: I edit for story, pacing, captions and sound, then prepare the first draft. You can follow the status, milestones and expected draft date at any time, and message me inside the project.
steps.youDo: Answer any quick questions I have.
steps.weDo: I edit, add captions and sound, and prepare the first draft.

steps.title: Feedback
steps.detail: Watch the draft in the review player and click the timeline to leave timestamped feedback. Send your notes as one revision round. Every version is kept, so you can compare V1, V2 and beyond.
steps.youDo: Leave feedback, then send it as a revision, or approve.
steps.weDo: I reply to each note, mark it resolved and upload the next version.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.detail: Approve the version you're happy with. Your final files (the master, social cuts, captions and source files where included) appear on a delivery page, ready to download.
steps.youDo: Approve the final version and download your final files.
steps.weDo: I prepare the deliverables and keep your project organised for next time.

about.headline: I turn raw footage into content people finish watching.
about.story:
I'm Faizan Ali, a video editor and content creator. I work with creators, consultants and service businesses to turn raw footage into clear, engaging videos.

Every project follows the same visible path (brief, footage, editing, feedback, delivery), so you always know what is happening and what I need from you.

values.title: Clear communication
values.body: One place for briefs, files, feedback and invoices.

values.title: Craft over templates
values.body: Edits shaped around your audience, not a preset.

values.title: Honest scope
values.body: Fixed quotes, defined revisions, no surprise bills.

values.title: Respect for your time
values.body: Fast replies, predictable turnarounds, easy approvals.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: This agreement is between {{studio_name}} (the “Editor”) and {{client_name}} of {{company}} (the “Client”), effective on the date the Client signs below.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 2. Project scope
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body:
The Editor will provide video editing services for the project “{{project_name}}” as described here:
{{scope}}

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 4. Turnaround
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: The first draft will be delivered within {{turnaround}} of the Editor receiving all required assets and the completed project brief. Delays in receiving assets or feedback extend the timeline accordingly.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 5. Payment terms
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: Total fee: {{total}}. A deposit of {{deposit}} is due on signing; any remaining balance of {{balance}} is due before final files are released, unless otherwise agreed in writing. Work begins once payment conditions for the deposit are met.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 6. Revisions
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: This agreement includes {{revision_rounds}} round(s) of revisions. A round is one consolidated set of notes on a delivered draft. Additional rounds, or changes to the agreed scope after production has started, are handled as a change request and may be quoted separately.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 7. Usage rights
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: On receipt of full payment the Editor grants the Client a perpetual, worldwide licence to use the final deliverables for the Client's business purposes. The Editor may display non-confidential excerpts in its portfolio unless the Client requests otherwise in writing.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 8. Confidentiality
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: Each party will keep the other's non-public materials confidential and use them only for this project. Client footage and assets are stored in access-controlled storage and only shared with team members working on the project.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 9. Cancellation
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: Either party may cancel with written notice. Work completed to the date of cancellation is billable. Deposits cover time reserved and work performed.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 10. Refunds
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: Because the Editor reserves time and begins work on payment, deposits are non-refundable once production has started. If the Editor cannot deliver the agreed scope, the Client will receive a refund for the undelivered portion.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 11. Ownership
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: The Client retains ownership of all supplied footage, brand assets and materials. The Editor retains ownership of its working files, templates and methods, except where source files are listed as deliverables.

CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.title: 12. Approval
CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.body: Approval of a version in the Editor's review portal confirms the deliverable meets the agreed requirements. After approval, further changes are treated as a new request.
